parsed.post: My latest experiment (1.092867) slightly improved my previous best (1.093102). The higher learning rate with warmup seems to be working. Since others are looking at regularization and architecture, I will pivot to explore the ASPECT_RATIO axis to see if increased model width helps.
parsed.description: Increase ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 to increase model capacity while keeping depth and LR constant.
